ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 92% coverage of black/near-black pixels and 8% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scarring and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular/annular geometric blobs are localized in the mid-left lobe (one prominent ring) and lower-right lobe (multiple smaller rings). Distal tips show high-density white pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth occupying roughly 12% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits moderate-amplitude peaks; right lobe features three primary high-amplitude peaks with significant micro-serration between the central notch and distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white annular pixel clusters detected. One large ring is visible at coordinate mid-left; a cluster of three smaller rings is visible in the lower-right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions observed diagonally on the lower-left ventral surface, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes consistent with barnacle attachment sites; dense white calcified clusters present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentration of high-intensity pixel clusters at the outer lateral edges, suggesting significant colonization by sessile organisms.
